{{Otheruses|Speaker}}
A '''speaker''',<ref name="SW6">[[Star Wars (1977) 6|''Star Wars'' (1977) 6]]</ref> '''comm speaker''',<ref name="Ringers">{{JournalCite|6|Ringers (short story)}}</ref> '''loudspeaker''',<ref name="FBS">''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]''</ref> or '''Audio Speaker'''<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a piece of technology that transmitted sounds<ref name="SW6" /> including voices.<ref name="Ringers" /> 

[[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] incorporated speakers in their design.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Speakers were components used in the [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]].
